chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: Seeing the country for the first time
summary: He loved touring Pittsburgh, Chicago and the South, having seen only Kansas City and Los Angeles.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, were you, were you enjoying the .....
That's really the point isn't it?
Yes. That's the thing. I had never seen the Country. I didn't know anything about the Country except the United States I had never seen any place except Kansas City and Los
Angeles. So when we went to Pittsburgh and Chicago and those places like that, that thrilled me a lot, you know. All down South, places down there I'd never seen or heard of them.
So being young like that and, it's like a lesson to you to learn, to see so many things. And I was enjoying it too. And then we .........
